frankenstein_2_design_delta.keep_principle: A causally prior enforcement decision must be consumed before real effect dispatch, and high-risk classes may require a non-self-grantable human capability.
frankenstein_2_design_delta.do_not_copy_as_authority: Regex/command-name parsing, typing heuristics, mutable user-owned guard files and path exceptions are historical donor mechanisms, not the EntityOS authority primitive.
frankenstein_2_design_delta.successor_contract: Bind EffectRequest -> AdmissionDecision -> EnforcementReceipt -> ExecutionReceipt -> WorldEffectVerification -> ResultReentry -> CompletionEvidence to one immutable per-invocation identity, exact request digest, generation and provenance. Missing or stale enforcement identity fails closed at the effect boundary; post-submission ambiguity remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
triggerword4_acceptance_addition: Pin the exact blocking adapter bytes/config/order used by the assembled host and bind its allow/deny result to invocation identity.
DENY must prove non-dispatch for that invocation.
A human capability receipt, when required, must be request-bound, single-use or narrowly scoped, expiring, non-self-grantable by model output and journaled separately from execution outcome.
Nested/indirect command paths must not bypass the same effect policy merely by changing shell/container/transport shape.
